study.question: Does the failure of norm-matched summary-gradient mean removal arise in the click branch, the auxiliary branches, or their interaction, and can auxiliary-only routing retain or improve the incumbent click AUC?
study.hypothesis: All-task summary mean removal confounds two distinct learning paths. The native coordinate-mean component may be useful to click-owned history/scorer learning while auxiliary-private history learning may tolerate or benefit from removing it. Applying norm-restored removal only to auxiliary summaries could preserve native click learning and improve later context transfer. This is provisional; latest evidence only establishes a failed all-task implementation, not benefit from selective routing.

nearest_work.difference: Exact product custom VJP and safe row norm are inherited unchanged. Replace its one all-task derivative choice with independently declared primary/auxiliary choices. Both/all-native endpoints bridge existing failed and successful trials; two mixed cells are unmeasured.

Retain incumbent architecture, task-specific context queries/history projections, ten compressed blocks and all native readouts. Candidate differs only in a selected first-order summary derivative during training, not its forward architecture.

Read exact-version primary sections 4.3 (lines 250-283) and local baseline implementation. Inherit unnormalized target local activation/Dice through the incumbent; the task-family derivative intervention is an adaptation and not an exact DIN reproduction or verified novelty.

Registry link-only text was unavailable; opened the authorized original https://arxiv.org/pdf/2508.11565v1 and read pages 1-4 (parsed lines 34-54, 120-196, 229-418). INFNet uses categorical/sequence/task tokens, compact proxies, heterogeneous cross attention and homogeneous PGUs. No such backbone is adopted: this suite localizes a backward-only task-family intervention inside the existing compressed product adapter. No priority claim; broader gradient-routing literature not exhaustively audited.

Inspected pinned lines 204-313: hub aggregation and affine gated broadcast, with mask-zeroing in benchmark attention. These differ from the unchanged local masked compression and selected surrogate VJP. Benchmark source is not proof of original-method equivalence.

inherited_components: Exact _SummaryProductVJP implementation, including native query derivative, live downstream RMS derivative, safe FP32 row norms, degenerate fallback and once_differentiable first-order contract from g0-r0067-summary_restored.
Every learned module, initialization and nonlearned running buffer from the incumbent and r0067 sources.
Uniform click and feedback auxiliary compression routes, target match/ordinal/curvature summaries and four task residual/product adapters.
Auxiliary scorer/item/action/target blocking, independent scorer moments, blocked auxiliary tower-context and enabled adapter-context transfer.
Frozen host training/loss/scoring; sum of four unweighted BCEs; no custom training-loss hook.
study.proposed_difference: At each task product use primary_summary_vjp for label is_click and auxiliary_summary_vjp for cart/fav/buy. Each independently selects native N=v*q or the inherited norm-restored R=(v-mean(v))*q, rescaled to ||N|| with native fallback when ||R||=0. v is the incoming product VJP after unchanged live RMS backward. The two-by-two suite changes only this branch selection; query VJP stays v*summary in every call. Auxiliary-only is the prospective candidate; primary-only localizes the complementary path; both and native are parity controls. No additional parameters/state, external data, losses or forward information.
predictions: If the task-specific hypothesis is useful, auxiliary_summary_direction (primary native; auxiliary removed_restored) exceeds the native_summary_bridge click AUC while primary_summary_direction loses AUC. No improvement is assumed.

Endpoint bridges reproduce r0067 all-native AUC 0.6685268680116033 and all-restored AUC 0.6679993260149861 within host numerical reproducibility; otherwise investigate implementation parity before interpreting mixed cells.

At common weights, inputs and upstream v, all four forwards and query VJPs agree; removal is confined to declared task summaries and preserves native row L2 norm, with explicit zero-direction fallback.

Report the factorial interaction A_both-A_primary-A_auxiliary+A_native, all task AUC/Logloss and predefined history slices. A nonzero interaction is trajectory-level evidence and needs repetitions; it is not automatically synergy.
falsifiers: Auxiliary-only fails to beat the all-native incumbent: no useful predictive improvement for this tested routing, even if it localizes the earlier loss.

If primary-only accounts for no loss but auxiliary-only reproduces it, reject the predicted primary-path explanation; retain the opposite localization as an observation. If both mixed cells lose, both task families may rely on the mean component.

If endpoint parity, equal common-state forwards/query VJPs, declared row-norm relation, source ownership, finite BF16 backward or frozen input/mask invariants fail, the implementation is not a valid contrast; record failed cost and repair before interpreting.

If apparent gain disappears under paired repetitions, or added measured cost dominates a tiny gain, do not promote it as a supported candidate. Neither a positive interaction nor an auxiliary metric improvement substitutes for click selection.
alternative_explanations: One training seed and adaptive validation reuse; no statistical significance or independent replication claim.
Norm is matched per sample at the summary output, not at history-projection parameters, accumulated sparse embeddings, global dense clipping or optimizer updates.

Auxiliary history inputs are detached: its modified summary VJP directly changes task-private history projections, and can affect shared context only indirectly through later updates and the host dense clipping multiplier.
Coordinate-mean removal depends on the learned latent basis; a task-family effect does not establish a basis-invariant signal or causal feature semantics.
The prior norm-restoration gain over raw removal was only 0.0000001159766841 AUC; stochastic/precision trajectory differences and parameter-level scaling remain unresolved.
A later auxiliary effect can follow changing private projection/tower learning rather than any direct improvement in shared history compression. No task-input label boundary is changed.

knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: None adopted from INFNet. Only inherited summary-VJP selection is made independent for click and auxiliary tasks.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No task proxy tokens, proxy cross attention, PGU or hub broadcast is introduced. Novelty remains unverified; source descriptions and outcomes do not imply local effectiveness.
